Supplies smallholder farmers in East Africa with seed, fertiliser, training and tree seedlings. GiveWell published 2 public models of its work; the most recent, from January 2023, puts it at **3.1× GiveDirectly (GW: 8.1× cash)**.

GiveWell states results as multiples of its cash benchmark. GiveDirectly itself scores about 2.6× that benchmark in GiveWell's own model, so GiveWell's multiples look 2.6 times smaller here, where everything is compared with GiveDirectly.

| [One Acre Fund seedlings BOTEC, 2022](/one-acre-fund) | GW | January 2023 | 3.1× GiveDirectly (GW: 8.1× cash) | 656, 32 kept fixed |
| [Updated value of information analysis of One Acre Fund's Rwanda seedlings RCT grant [2024]](/one-acre-fund/one-acre-fund-updated-value-information-rwanda) | GW | January 2023 | 3.2× GiveDirectly (GW: 8.2× cash) | 656, 32 kept fixed |
